affected_version: Exact published 0.5.2 tarball contains the same pathname-based guide and verbose-core reads. Runtime failing-before proof used equivalent prepatch candidate; earlier releases unassessed.
invariant: Guide and verbose core-list readers accept only contained regular files with finite byte bounds before exposing content. Shared bounded reads enforce actual read bytes rather than only an earlier stat and reject special-file input without waiting for a FIFO writer.
strategy: Use existing root-aware contained reader; preserve native core-list path resolution, missing/blank/Unicode/list parsing behavior and nonverbose laziness. Guide and default list limit use existing 8 MiB node-body precedent; buildPack passes an explicit maxBodyBytes when supplied. Strengthen the shared reader at its actual descriptor-read boundary.
before: 13 discovery regressions failed: linked guide/list content was exposed, dangling guide was treated as absent rather than rejected, oversized guide printed. Two additional shared-reader regressions failed: post-stat growth exceeded the bound and FIFO input timed out before type validation.

review: Fresh independent prepatch investigation and one fresh candidate review. No surviving static-input bypass or regression found. Reviewer did not execute tests; parent performed runtime checks above. Final task-828 exact-range security diff review remains open.
limitations: Concurrent parent-directory replacement can defeat path-based containment; leaf O_NOFOLLOW and descriptor type checks are not portable openat. This stronger active local filesystem-actor threat is outside the supported single-writer/static-checkout guarantee.
The original verbose disclosure reaches returned warnings and CLI stderr, not ordinary serialized pack content. MCP/handoff currently hard-code verbose false.
